verdict.rationale: Blaxel has dedicated first-party docs for explicit egress policy. Sandboxes can restrict which external domains, HTTP methods, and URL paths they reach using allowlists and denylists (blaxel-docs-28). Outbound traffic is routed through Blaxel's proxy with per-domain firewalls (blaxel-docs-27). Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that the policies are enforced, and evidence of IP/port-level controls for non-HTTP egress beyond the domain-based proxy.
